vol.reset2fa: Bongisa lisusu authentification na matambe mibale
vol.reset2faBody: Salelá yango soki moto abungisi telefone na ye. Akobima bisika nyonso mpe asengeli kotia application ya sika. Tala liboso nani azali (libengi, bokutani).
sandbox.location: Tinda esika (ya yo, to Paris République soki eboyami)
places.notLocatedHelp: Adresi emonani na carte te: esika etikali na liste ya mokolo, kasi epesamaka te epai ya bato oyo bakabolaka esika na bango. Tala adresi (nimero, balabala, engumba).
more.associations: Salá ba-associations mpe pona ba-administrateurs na yango
assoc.title: Ba-associations
assoc.intro: Association nyonso ezali na ba-administrateurs na yango: bandimaka bokomisi ya ba-bénévoles na bango mpe bakoki kobyanga bango na lien.
assoc.createHelp: Luka yango na registre ya leta mpo bokomisi oyo eponi yango ekóma epai ya ba-administrateurs na yango.
assoc.name: Nkombo ya association
assoc.exists: Association oyo esili kozala na Wilson.
assoc.noAdmin: Administrateur ezali naino te: masɛngi ekendaka epai ya ba-administrateurs ya Wilson.
assoc.addAdminHelp: Moto akɔti na association. Akoki kondima bokomisi, kobyanga ba-bénévoles mpe kobongisa makoki na bango, mpo na association oyo kaka.
assoc.removeAdminBody: {name} atikali membre ya {association} kasi akoki lisusu kondima to kobyanga te. Session na ye ekangami.
join.title: Kɔta na Wilson
join.intro: {name} abyangi yo. Compte na yo ekosala kaka ntango esalemi.
join.introNoAssociation: Babyangi yo okɔta na Wilson. Compte na yo ekosala kaka ntango esalemi.
join.invalid: Lien ya libyangi oyo esalaka lisusu te (esalelamaki, elongolamaki to esilaki). Okoki kaka kotinda lisɛngi.
join.doneText: Kɔta na imeyili mpe mot de passe na yo.
inv.title: Byanga bénévole
inv.intro: Lien ya kosalela mbala moko, esalaka mikolo 7. Moto akɔti na {name} kozela bondimi te.
inv.introGlobal: Lien ya kosalela mbala moko, esalaka mikolo 7. Moto azwi compte oyo ezali kosala kozela bondimi te.
inv.label: Ezali mpo na nani?
inv.labelPlaceholder: ndakisa Sami, permanence ya mokolo ya mibale
inv.readyBody: Tindela moto yango yo moko (WhatsApp, SMS, imeyili). Emonanaka mbala moko kaka: kopiá yango sikoyo.
inv.shareText: Kɔta elongo na {name} na Wilson mpo na kosalisa bato tozali kosalisa:
inv.emptySub: Salá lien na “Byanga” mpe tindela moto yango.
inv.noLabel: Libyangi oyo ezali na nkombo te

vol.memberLosesAdmin: Kobongola association elongolaka rôle ya administrateur.
